prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 40 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1421; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of cervical and lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the force of the impact is in keeping with soft tissue injury to the neck and low back. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of the injury. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is known. Over the course of care, the patient has completed approximately 40 visits. Treatment has expanded over several months, with additional modalities and services added over time beyond what is typically required for a strain of this nature. Billing records reviewed show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing management includes home exercise instruction, activity modification, and periodic reassessment of range of motion and pain levels. Continued monitoring is recommended, with a plan to taper care as symptoms resolve.
